verdict.rationale: Jobs run asynchronously in the background, and webhooks notify you when they complete, fail or change state, so you don't have to poll (llamaparse-docs-6). Saved classification configurations can also be reused across jobs (llamaparse-docs-39), and a hosted pipeline is offered for RAG indexing (llamaparse-docs-19). However, every job still has to be started by the caller's own code; nothing shows the platform setting up or running automations on its own. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring jobs, event triggers such as new files in a watched source, user-configurable autonomous workflows, and any independent or hands-on evidence of unattended background operation.
